{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for customers who converted (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out those with age = -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_age_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age_converted = valid_age_converted['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Mean age of converted customers (excluding age = -1): {mean_age_converted}')"}
